To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) the piecewise rigid scene assumption enables us to define a suitable prior for 3D motion, (2) a view-consistent, multi-frame formulation is beneficial for 3D scene reconstruction, and (3) our method currently achieves leading results on the KITTING benchmark, for both 2D and 3D scene estimation

(1) the piecewise rigid scene assumption enables us to jointly recover geometry and motion from stereo image sequences, (2) a view-consistent scheme improves accuracy and robustness, (3) we achieve state-of-the-art performance on the Kitti stereo and flow benchmarks.

1) piecewise rigid scene flow estimation is a promising approach to 3D scene reconstruction and motion estimation, 2) the proposed view-consistent multi-view multi-frame scheme is a powerful tool to increase robustness and accuracy, and 3) the proposed approach achieves state of the art results on the KITTING benchmark.
